description_sq:
Kjo vilë elegante ndodhet në një rezidencë ekskluzive në zonën e Linzës, vetëm 20 minuta nga qendra e Tiranës dhe 15 minuta nga TEG. E pozicionuar larg zhurmës së qytetit, prona ofron një stil jetese të qetë, të rrethuar nga ajër i pastër dhe gjelbërim natyror.
Vila ka një pamje panoramike spektakolare mbi një pyll mimozash dhe mbi të gjithë qytetin e Tiranës, duke krijuar një balancë të rrallë mes natyrës dhe jetesës urbane.
Prona ka një sipërfaqe totale ndërtimi prej 297 m², e shoqëruar me një oborr privat prej 170 m², i certifikuar si truall.
Në hyrje ju mirëpret një oborr privat që shërben gjithashtu si zonë parkimi.

description_en: This elegant villa is located in an exclusive residence in the Linza area, only 20 minutes from the center of Tirana and 15 minutes from TEG. Positioned away from the hustle and bustle of the city, the property offers a peaceful lifestyle, surrounded by fresh air and natural greenery. The villa has a spectacular panoramic view over a mimosa forest and over the entire city of Tirana, creating a rare balance between nature and urban living. The property has a total construction area of ​​297 m², accompanied by a private courtyard of 170 m², certified as land. At the entrance you are greeted by a private courtyard that also serves as a parking area. Interior arrangement First floor: Spacious living room Kitchen area Guest toilets Storage Balcony Lower floor: Distribution corridor Two bedrooms Toilets Laundry Large balcony serving all bedrooms Also, the property includes an exclusive matrimonial suite with: Spacious bedrooms Private toilets Walk-in wardrobe Large veranda Property features: Facade with thermal insulation system (hoods) Chiller system with heating in floor Solar panel system Functional fireplace Electric vehicle charging station connected to solar panels For more information or to arrange a visit, contact me!
